author: LeCobalt
body:
Hello there guys! I come on behalf of Raging Inc., a team dedicated to build quality maps. We have built maps for quite a while, actually since the middle age of Avicus 1.0. 

Pros:

  • We have build for many servers, but one of the main has been Avicus. 
  • We have a Website! Raging Builds  (Designed with luv by Adri<3)
  • We have a build server!
  • We have world coders ready to teach you how to code a minecraft world for max gaming performance!
  • Most of our builds are saved in a database for easy recolection.
  • We luv each other<3!

   We are requesting more builders, because, as some of you may know, half of our team broke apart as another new team rose.

                                    "Build On!"

                            Website 




Members:

  • Podcrash (Owner)
  • Jake (Owner)
  • Adrian (Head Dev) (Tf2 Division)
  • Cobalt (Build Director) (Tf2 Division)
  • Cezbla (Server Owner) 
  • Resepignev (Builder)
  • Cezbla (Builder)
  • Herobrine (Builder) (Tf2 Division)
  • Slicorn (Builder)
  • Steven (Builder)
  • Cole (Builder)
  • Dabader (Builder)

Requirements:

  • Must build decently
  • Must have creativity
  • Must have fun
  • Must know how to work in a team

Application:

How would you contribute to the build team?
Why do you want to join the build team?
How trustworthy are you in your opinion?
Picture of one of your builds: (Put picture here)

We hope you join!:D
